fact: 章首日期抬头：Friday, May 1, 2065（Alba is 7 and 9）——两个 Alba 同时在场，一个 7 岁一个 9 岁；叙述者是 Alba
两个 Alba 在黑暗的黄房子里跑，压低声音说话；Other Alba 拍她肩膀，她追下楼，跳过坏掉的最下面两级台阶
quote: We run through the Yellow House in the dark. We whisper even though nobody else is here, because the dark might hear us. Other Alba tags me on the shoulder, so I chase her down the stairs. We jump over the broken bottom two steps
anchor: Alba: We run through the Yellow House in the dark.

fact: 厨房里有东西摔碎，Other Alba 撞到膝盖；手电筒电池全没电；Other Alba 在抽屉里找到半盒火柴，说这不是玩，去找蜡烛，拿回七支插在酒瓶里的蜡烛（Mama 说过不许玩火柴）
quote: I hear a crash and she says oh shit … she bashed her knee. We feel around for the flashlights but the batteries are all dead. Other Alba finds a big box half full of wooden matches in a drawer. Mama always says don’t play with matches but Other Alba tells me to shut up, this isn’t playing … Other Alba comes back with seven candles, long and short ones, stuck into wine bottles.
anchor: We jump over the broken bottom two steps, she runs

fact: 地下室有水，水位高到蜡烛照出镜面、照出两人的倒影；通往地下室的楼梯已经没了，Other Alba 警告不要进去，并把她拉开、关上门
quote: “Yeah. I’ll show you in a minute.” … “Come see.” She opens the door to the basement. “Don’t go in, the stairs are gone.” She holds the candle up and the candle makes the dark water like a mirror and I can see me and Other Alba, we look funny in the too-big clothes. … Other Alba pulls me away, gives me the candle and shuts the basement door.
anchor: she says. She gets to decide because she’s older.

fact: 食橱几乎空了，只找到一罐 SpaghettiOs；冰箱里漆黑、气味难闻、没有电；抽屉里毛巾被咬成窝；用开罐器和两把勺子轮流吃，吃完她还饿
quote: The shelves are mostly empty. … The thing I saw turns out to be a can of SpaghettiOs. … I go to open the fridge but Other Alba says, “Don’t!” I do it anyway and there’s an awful smell … the fridge is black inside … “There’s no electricity.” I open a drawer and find some towels all chewed into a nest. … She cleans them with her T-shirt, opens the can, and we take turns eating. When it’s gone I’m still hungry.

fact: 壁炉里塞满灰、树枝和纸，还有揉成团的乐谱；她说“看，是音乐”，Other Alba 说楼上音乐室地板上到处都是音乐、壁橱开着；她不能看这些乐谱，因为“已经知道曲子怎么走的人怎么写得出音乐”；她把乐谱揉回原样放回去
quote: There’s ashes all over and a bunch of branches and paper stuffed into the fireplace, like someone was going to make a fire. “Look, it’s music,” I say. I pull a balled-up sheet out of the pile, uncrumple it. “There’s music all over the floor upstairs,” she says. “In the music room. And the closet is open.” … I know I am not supposed to look at this music because how can you write music if you already know how it goes? … “But why is it in the fireplace?” “Maybe we don’t need it anymore.” … I ball the music up like how it was and put it back where I got it.

fact: 她醒来时独自一人，Other Alba 的位置还有余温；蜡烛快烧尽；楼上楼下两个马桶都干涸发褐、没有卫生纸、水龙头空响；音乐室里只有一架琴键大半缺失的立式钢琴、满地乐谱、纸上有鞋印、床垫不见了、另一间卧室门关着她不敢开
quote: . . . I wake up alone in the dark. Other Alba’s place in the blankets is still kind of warm. The candles have burned most of the way down. … the downstairs and upstairs toilets are both dry and brown inside … The faucet makes an empty sound when I turn it on, so I can’t wash my hands. … just the upright piano standing in the middle of the room with its keys mostly missing, no bench, just music everywhere. There are shoe prints on the pages and some are torn. … but the mattress is gone. The other bedroom door is closed; I’m afraid to open it.
anchor: We hug each other to be warmer . . . . . . I wake

fact: 两只老鼠靠近蜡烛，一只坐起来嗅、爪子像小手；蜡烛要倒的瞬间她回到自己房间，Mama 抱着她问“你去哪了”，她哭着说“我害怕，妈妈，有老鼠”，Mama 说“你回家了，宝贝，没事了”
quote: Something scratches and thumps, and then I see two rats looking at me … One of the rats sits up, sniffing. Its paws are like little hands. … it’s going to jump up—no please don’t—the candle is about to tip over—then I’m home, I’m home, I’m in my own room, Mama is here, she hugs me and says where did you go? and I cry, I was scared, Mama, there were rats, and she says you’re home now, sweetie, it’s okay, everything’s okay
